content: Lázaro wanungan
Chauraga gueshyarunag Lázaro nipäcungan runam. Payga yachrara Betania ichic marcalachrümi ishcay paninwan. Paycunapa jutin cara Mariawan Martam.
Chay gueshyag Lazaropa panin Mariam cara taytanchipa chraquinman perfümita jirpurcur chay agchanwan chaquichig.
Chauraga chay panincunam ishcay junag camiñu aywanata cachrarärimunag Jesusman “Tayta, cuyangaymi gueshyayan” nipäcunanpag.

Nipäcugta mayarur Jesusga cay ninmi: “Cay gueshyaga charirun manam imaycamas wanusha cananpagchu. Antis chay gueshyaga charirun Dios munayniyog cananganta musyapäcunanpagmi, jinaman Diospa-mayin munayniyog cangäta runacuna musyapäcunanpagmi”.
Jesusga aliscam cuyara Martatas nanantas turin Lazarotas.
Nätan Lázaro gueshyayanganta musyayarsi chaychru cara ishcay junagran.
Chaypitam discïpuluncunata cay nipäcaman: “Aywashun yapay Judeata”.
Nipäcamaptinmi nogacunaga cay nirärï: “Yachrachig, quima chruscu junaglaragtag cayan wacchru mandagcuna chapiypa wanuchiyta munapäcushungay. Nätan ¿yapaychu wac aywayta munayanqui?”
Nipäcuptïmi Jesusga cay nipäcaman: “Manam üraragchu wanuchipäcamänanpag. Chrunca ishcayniyog üratam noganchiga juc junag ninchi. ¿Au? Chaura junagpa purirga manam mitcanchichu achicyaptin.
Nätan pagaspa purirga mitcanchi mana achicyaptinmi. Chaynuymi mana wanuchiyta atipapäcamangachu mana ürä chrämuptinga”.
Nircurmi Jesusga cay nin: “Cuyanacunganchi Lazaroga nämi jamayan. Nätan aywayä sharcachigmi”.
Nipäcamaptin discïpuluncunaga cay nipäcümi: “Tayta, chaura jamayarga sharcungachri”.
Nätan Jesusga Lázaro wanusham nipäcamänagmi. Chaytam nogacunaga tantiarärinä jamaypita rimayanganta.
Chaura Jesusga shumagmi musyarärichiman cay nir: “Lazaroga wanusham.
Cushirayämi chaychru mana cangäpita. Chaynuy mana cangä gamcunapag mas alim, ‘Payga razonpa Diospitam’ nir mas yupachicarcämänaypag. Chauraga aywashun ricag” nipäcaman.
Nipäcamaptinmi mellïshu nipäcungä Tomasga: “Noganchisi aywashun paywan parëju wanunanchi captinsi” nipäcaman.
“Nogam cä cawachigsi, nätan wanushapita cawacächimugsi” Jesús ningan
Nä Betaniaman chrarur Jesusga Lazarota tarirun nä chruscu junag enterracusha cayagtam.
Chay marca cara manam alä caruchrüchu Jerusalenpita. Caraga lamitä lïwapita mascascalam.
Nätan achcam Diospa wayinchru uryagcuna aywarärimunag Martata Mariata “Amar wagaychu turiquipita” nipäcunanpag.
Chaura Martaga nä wayinman nachrgayagta Jesuspita musyarurga yargaramun taripacugmi, nätan Mariaga wayinchrümi quëdaramunag.
Chaura Martaga Jesusta cay ninmi: “Tayta, caychru gam captiquiga manachr wanunmanchu cara turilä.
Nätan musyayämi Diosta canan manacuruptiqui mayashunaytas”.
Niptinmi Jesusga cay nin: “Turiquiga cawacämungam”.
Niptinmi Martaga cay nin: “Au. Musyayämi wanushacuna cawacämunan junagchru cawacämunanta”.
Chaura niptinga cay nirunmi: “Nogam cayä wanushata cawacächimugsi, nätan cawachigsi. Pi maysi chrasquicamagga wanursi cawacämungam.
Nätan lapan cawayagcunasi chrasquimagga manam imaycamas wanushalachu capäcunga. ¿Cay niyangäta ‘Razonmi’ ninquichu?”
Niptinmi cay nin: “Au tayta. Cananga shumagmi musyarü ‘Salvacugtam cachramushag’ Dios ningan jinaman Diospa-mayin gam cangayta”.
Nircur Martaga aywacun nanan María gayagmi. Jinarcurmi japalanta cay nin: “Yachrachigmi chrarayämun. Gamtam gayayäshunqui”.
Niruptin Mariaga pasay-pacham aywaramunag.
Chaypagga manam Jesusga yaycuraragchu marcaman. Cayara Martawan tincungalanchrümi.
Chaura María wayrala sharcurcur yargamugta ricarärirga chay wayinchru cayag runacunaga gatirapäcamunag “Mïchucagtachr aywayan wagag” nipäcurmi.
Chaura Jesús cayanganman María chraramurga, Jesuspa naupanmanmi gongorpacuyun cay nir: “Tayta, caychru gam captiquiga manachr wanunmanchu cara turilä”
nir, wagacuptinga, jinaman paywan carcayag runacunatas wagarcayagta ricapururga Jesusga aliscam laquicurun jinamanmi cuyaparun.
Chaypitam tapurun: “¿Maymantag enterrarärinqui?” Niptinmi “Tayta, shamuy ricanaypag” nirärin.
Nätan Jesusga wagacunmi.
Chaura chay sacerdöticunapa mandagnincunaga “¡Jay, aliscachrau cuyara!” nipäcunmi.
Nätan waquincagmi runacunaga “Cay runa chay ñaushapa ñawintas cuticayächirga manachrau imalatas rurayta atiparachu Lázaro mana wanunanpag” nipäcuratan.
Lazarota Jesús cawacächimungan
Chaura Jesusga yapay alisca laquisham mïchucagman ashuyurun. Chay mïchu canag juc machraymi juc jatun lagta rumiwan wichrgasha.
Chaura Jesusga “Rumita jorgapäcuy” ninmi. Chaymi wanushapa panin Martaga cay nin: “Tayta, nächri asyarirayan, nämi wanunganga chruscu junag”.
Niptin Jesusga cay ninmi: “¿Manachu nogaman yupachicurga Dios munayniyog canganta ricanquim nirag?” nir.
Chauraga jorgarärin rumitam. Chaypitam Jesusga jana pachata rircärir cay nin: “Tayta, ‘Gracias’ nicug, gamta manacungänuy rurangaypitam.
Noga musyayämi chaynuyla mayamangayta. Nätan niyagsi caychru runacuna,
gam cachramangayta musyarur yupachicarcämänanpagmi”. Nircurmi gayacuypanuy: “¡Lázaro, yargamuy chaypita!” nirun.
Chaura wanushaga yargaramun maquinpita, chraquincama inchrasham. Nätan cäranmi juc sagpiwan wancusha. Chaura Jesusga “Pasquipäcuy purinanpag” ninmi.
Jesusta wanuchipäcunanpag rimanacungan
Chauraga María ricag chay aywamusha sacerdöticunapa mandagnincunaga achcam chrasquicarärin Jesusta chay Lázaro cawacächimugta ricarärir.
Nätan waquinmi aywapäcusha fariseocunaman Jesús chay ruranganta willapacug.

Chaura fariseocunawan sacerdöticunapa waquin mandagnincunaga gotucarärinag quiquin mandagcamalam rimanacurcänanpag. Chaychrümi cay ninacurcasha: “¿Imatatag rurachwan chay runata? Aliscatag ima-aygatas rurayan mana pisi ruray atipänancunata.

Jinata rircarashaga cay runanchicunaga lapanmi chrasquicaräringa. Jinatam Romachru mandagcunaga aywarcärimur Diospa wayintas jinaman noganchi acrashan runancunatas imantawansi pampanman rurarämäshun”.
Nätan nipäcuptinshi paycuna castapita Caifás nipäcunganga, chay wata Diospa wayinchru mas mandagnincagga cay nin: “Gamcunaga manam musyapäcunquichu.
Manatan tantiapäcunquipishchu alitaga. Nogapitaga cay lapan runacunapa janan juclay runalam wanunman lapanchita ushamänanpitaga” nirun.
Nätan Caifás chaynuy nira manam quiquinpa yarpaylanpitachu, antis nira chay wata Diospa wayinchru mas mandagnincag carmi, Tayta Dios rimachiptin, Israel casta runacunapa janan Jesús wanunanpita.
Manam cay runacunalapagchu, antis Diospa lapan castancuna maychru chaychru cagtas juclaman gotunanpagmi.
Chaura chay junagpitam chay mandagcunaga rimanacusha capäcura Jesusta wanuchipäcunanpag.
Chaymi Jesusga nä mana purirachu chay mandagcuna ricayga. Antis Judea ninganpitaga yargor, aywacura jäpag pampaman Efraín ningan marcacagpam. Chaychrümi Jesús cara nogacuna discïpuluncunawan.

Chauraga nämi pasay nachrgarayämura Pascua nipäcungä fiestäcunapag. Jinarcurmi chay marcacunapita runacunaga achca aywapäcura Jerusalenta manaragsi fiesta chrämuptilan Dios ningannuy maylacurcänanpag.
Chaura chay runacunaga Jesustam ashipäcunag, nätan Diospa wayinchrüga tapucurcänag jucta juctam: “¿Ima nipäcunquitag? ¿Aywamungachur fiestaman icha manachur?” nir.
Nätan fariseocunawan, sacerdöticunapa mandagnincunaga rimanacarärinag maychrüsi Jesús cayagta pisi musyarga willacurcänanpagmi, chaypita charig aywapäcunanpagmi.
